scope: disposable local multiplayer Milestone 2 capability-framework acceptance

registry.persistent_payload_policy: primitive finite scalar/table values only; depth, entry count, cycles, functions and userdata are rejected
registry.runtime_policy: engine objects remain only in a weak body-keyed runtime table and are omitted from snapshots

native_craft_through_registry.authority_route: disposable server-only acceptance hook -> Brain.setTask -> Jobs.prepare -> capability registry -> GoblinCrafting -> server-side Storm native craft adapter
native_craft_through_registry.notes: The installed native recipe consumed the single explicit fixture log and produced three real plank instances in the managed Goblin inventory. The registry did not infer completion from dispatch; it reported COMPLETE only after the native craft adapter returned success.

proves: the additive registry loads on the target game build with server-side Storm and ordinary clients
the four existing server job handlers are registered with explicit policy metadata
a real existing CRAFT order crosses the registry and emits structured active and terminal results
the representative native operation consumes a real Base.Log and produces three real Base.Plank items
one persistent Goblin still spawns for each of two connected players
does_not_prove: player-chat command authentication because the disposable acceptance hook called the existing internal Brain boundary
second-client observation of the crafted inventory delta
physical multiplayer completion of FARM, REPAIR_VEHICLE or CLOSE_CURTAINS
completion of any later tools, access, logistics, survival, vehicle, Reflex, goal or Offline Life milestone

milestone_2.release_boundary: Local milestone acceptance only. Nothing was committed, pushed, published, deployed or changed in production. Individual job abilities retain their separate catalog proof gaps.
